To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) Off-the-Hook has an accuracy of 99.8% on a test set of phishing websites and 99.9% on a test of legitimate websites; and (2) Off-the-Hooks accuracy is not affected by changes in the phishing techniques used by phishers, nor by changes in the target website that is mimicked by the phishing website.
Off-the-Hook has a high accuracy (95.8% for static phish and 91.7% for dynamic phish), is fast, and is easy to use.
Off-the-Hook provides a new approach for phishing detection that is highly accurate, brand-independent, language-independent and resilient to dynamic phish.
